title: Polska Press ownership and control
summary: Polska Press is a Polish regional and local news publisher owned 100% by ORLEN. ORLEN’s disclosed shareholders include Poland’s State Treasury (49.90%) and Nationale-Nederlanden OFE (5.26%). The state also holds special voting and appointment rights. August 2026 reporting describes a planned sale of Polska Press, without announcing completion.

edges.description: ORLEN’s first-quarter report lists Polska Press at 100%. Register-derived information identifies ORLEN as the direct holder of all 12,000 shares. August reporting corroborates continuing ownership while a sale remains planned.

edges.description: The State Treasury holds 579,310,079 shares, representing 49.90% of capital and total voting rights.
The pension fund holds 61,070,000 shares, representing 5.26% of capital and total voting rights.
The disclosed remainder comprises 520,561,970 shares and the same number of votes, or 44.84%.

ORLEN describes special state control powers. Its general 10% voting cap exempts the State Treasury and state subsidiaries. This edge records those legal privileges rather than an additional equity interest.

gaps: Polska Press denotes the publishing group, not an individual news title; the root therefore uses the publisher entity.
No completed sale was found in the searches. The latest opened sale reporting is dated 10 August 2026; subsequent changes remain possible.
Polska Press’s corporate pages and an ownership masthead failed to open. Direct ownership was corroborated with a register-derived secondary source rather than an official current KRS extract.
The ownership observations have different dates. ORLEN’s shareholder page explicitly references 9 June 2026; the opened primary Polska Press percentage is from the first-quarter 2026 report.

The annual-report control page does not give a precise observation date. An opened 17 August 2026 statutory-change notice concerned business activities, but the consolidated statute attachment was not inspected.
The fund manager is the third relationship level; its shareholders and the pension fund’s individual beneficiaries were not traced. Wikidata identifiers were not verified.
